India May Send B-Team to Asian Games Over Japan's Poor Facilities

The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) and the Asian Cricket Council (ACC) have expressed dissatisfaction with the facilities provided in Japan for the 2026 Asian Games cricket tournament. Concerns include dressing rooms located in tents and washrooms situated 500 meters away. Japan has stated it lacks the manpower and budget to accommodate the increased number of participants. Consequently, India is considering sending a second-string team to the Games if the arrangements do not improve.
